_readme: Names and groups the projects on the owner's morning page. It holds NO status: activity, walks owed and
'gone quiet' are worked out by scripts/owner-brief.mjs from the history, the QA ledger and the roadmap record.
files  = plan-file basenames in docs/projects/active (or the roadmap record) whose history is the project's activity.
ledger = words that appear in this project's QA ledger section titles, so its owed walks attach to it.
state  = open | parked | closed. Parked needs parked: { since, reason } in the owner's words. Only the owner parks or closes.
A plan file not listed here still shows on the page under its file name, marked unregistered, so nothing new can hide.
